reason: I don't have money for a monthly subscription. My parents pay for everything I spend on, and INR 299 a month is a lot of their money for something I'd only use when I feel like studying. The free start is fine, but I wouldn't ask them for this.
objection: Why would I pay every month when the college placement cell already runs training and tests for free? I'd rather wait for what the college gives us.
would_change_my_mind: If the placement cell or college paid for it, or if my parents agreed to cover it as a one-time thing before placements, I'd try it.
